name: Gold Rush
author: byo-pop
description: A game mode: turn every cell of a 7 x 7 board to gold before the level's time runs out, while the gems fall down, then up, after each move that matches, so the board fills from both edges in turn. A match gilds the cells it clears. Each level has 4 minutes in Normal and 2 in Timed, 10 seconds less each level, and each second left over scores points. A board with no moves refills. Uses its own high-score table.
